ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aura uses the camera to scan your partner's invite QR code and to take photos and videos for your memories.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aura uses your photo library so you can choose a profile photo and add photos and videos to your memories, chat and letters.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Aura saves the photos you choose, such as your year-in-review image, to your photo library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aura uses the microphone to record voice messages, the voice part of your memories and videos.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aura uses your location only when you choose to share where you are in chat, tag a memory or show your weather. It is stored at city level.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aura uses Face ID to lock the app so only you can open your shared space.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Aura adds the dates you plan together to your phone calendar.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Aura adds the dates you plan together to your phone calendar.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Aura adds the dates you plan together to your phone calendar.
